hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/rockygap.aspx ('278 individual campsites (including 30 equipped with 30 amp electric hook-ups ...)'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The booking site lists 258 campsites (33 electric, 225 non-electric) besides 10 mini cabins, a yurt and group sites; the park page says 278 individual campsites, a figure that includes the cabins and yurt. Listed equipment lengths run 20 to 40 ft; 27 sites are pull-through.

sites.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/rocky-gap-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380125 (all 11 pages of the site list, read 2026-10-20)

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/rockygap.aspx (dump station, bathhouses with hot water in each loop, camp store) + the ReserveAmerica facility page (Services and Amenities: Showers, Dump Station, Camp Store), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Rocky Gap's booking page: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.' Walk-in use may be available before and after the reservable season; contact the park.

Campground closed for renovation (pads, amenities, accessibility, utilities). DNR's park page: October 13, 2026 through December 31, 2027. ReserveAmerica's park alert: October 2026 to January 2029, 'welcoming you back for the 2029 camping season'. Its availability grid still showed Ash Loop sites open after the closure began (2026-10-20).

summary: Confirmed fees ($21.50 / $27.50 electric, +$1 weekends on the booking table), season and the renovation closure on the DNR page. Added 30-amp electric, 258 sites up to 40 ft with pull-throughs, showers/dump/camp store, and the park's own booking window (365 days, closes 1 day before arrival) over the inherited values. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min stay, fcfs beyond 'walk-in use may be available'. Status: both reopening dates recorded (DNR 2028, ReserveAmerica 2029).
